title: Cover launcher registration and preflight request rewrites in a positive run-wait regression
outcome: A positive wait regression follows actual launcher order: durable registration, wait before fingerprint publication, registration-field rewrite, fingerprint rewrite, matching terminal PASS.
acceptance: The regression creates the wait before expectedFingerprint is published, then performs both launcher request.json rewrites.
Request identity and native locator remain matched, the wait does not falsely pin a later fingerprint, and exactly one PASS resume is queued.
Existing negative request/locator/pinned-fingerprint substitution tests remain unchanged and pass.
